base_rule: enumerate all lifts from the frozen x-subspace, multiply by h, retain distinct nonidentity r-subgroup points sorted by encoded coordinates; record direct eligibility and duplicate/identity counts
index_rule: store the first ordered pair for each distinct subgroup sum; retain all B^2 attempted pairs and distinct-key count; no scalar-coordinate oracle in candidate lookup
targets: 32 SHA256-derived nonzero scalars h4-n29-target-i modulo r, multiplied by G solely to construct frozen reproducible public points; independent of index content
lookup_rule: for each public target Q, scan the sorted cleared base C and test Q-C against the first-pair index; stop on first group-verified triple or exhaustion; retain every status and elapsed time
host: ordinary local macOS checked Sage; algorithmic diagnostic, not an isolated CPU timing tier
